3. Add temperature - 2018 Birch - daymet
```{r}
# ------------------------------------ Get Daymet Data ------------------------------------ #
# download the Daymet data
library(daymetr)  # for getting Daymet data
library(ncdf4)  # for processing .nc data
library(janitor)  # for detecting cols with all records empty
library(gstat)  # for interpolation
library(sp)
library(sf)

folder.raw <- '~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/Daymet'

download_Daymet <- TRUE
if (download_Daymet){
  # get LST extent
  bbox <- as.vector(terra::ext(ny_boundary))
  # download Daymet data
  download_daymet_ncss(location = bbox[c('ymax', 'xmin', 'ymin', 'xmax')],
                       start = 2018, end = 2018,
                       frequency = "annual",
                       param = c("tmin","tmax"),
                       path=folder.raw)
}
daymet_files <- list.files(folder.raw, "*.nc")

# open the netCDF variables
tmax.nc <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/Daymet/tmax_annavg_2018_ncss.nc")
tmin.nc <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/Daymet/tmin_annavg_2018_ncss.nc")

roi_sf <- sf::read_sf('data/raw/CONUS/boundary/us_boundary.shp')
us_boundary <- st_transform(roi_sf, crs = st_crs(4326))
usboun_reproj <- sf::st_transform(us_boundary, crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(tmax.nc,proj = T)))

tmax <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(tmax.nc, terra::ext(usboun_reproj)),
                                    usboun_reproj), terra::crs(us_boundary))
tmin <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(tmin.nc, terra::ext(usboun_reproj)), 
                                    usboun_reproj), terra::crs(us_boundary))

tmax_spring <- (tmax[[3]]+tmax[[4]]+tmax[[5]])/3
tmin_spring <- (tmin[[3]]+tmin[[4]]+tmin[[5]])/3

tavg_ann <- (tmax[[1]] + tmin[[1]])/2
```

4. Add temperature - 2018 Birch - landsat

```{r}
library(sp)
library(sf)

lst_2018 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/year_mean/2018.tif")
lst_2018_betula <- extract(lst_2018, betula_points)
betula_points$lst_2018 <- lst_2018_betula
hist(lst_2018_betula)

r_df <- rasterToPoints(lst_2018, spatial = TRUE) |> as.data.frame()
names(r_df) <- c("value", "x", "y")
betula_200_bld_forstats_alan <- left_join(betula_200_bld_forstats_alan, betula_points, by = "id")%>%
  select(-taxa.y) %>%
  select(-site.y) %>%
  select(-geometry.y)
```


5. Relationship - visualize

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpmisc)
library(gridExtra)
source("script/read_tree_inventory.R")
cityoi <- "NY"
df_tree <- read_tree_inventory(city = cityoi)
coordinates(df_tree) <- c("lon", "lat")
point_tree <- st_as_sf(df_tree)
point_tree <- st_set_crs(point_tree, "EPSG:4326")

taxa = "Vacant"
# v_taxa <- c("Quercus", "Morus", "Ulmus", "Fraxinus", "Betula", "Acer", "Populus", "Vacant")
taxa_alan_temp <- extract_temp_alan(point_tree, taxa)

p <- plot_function(taxa = taxa, dataframe=taxa_alan_temp, taxa_alan_temp$alan_2018, taxa_alan_temp$up_05_2018, "ALAN_2018", "green_up_doy")
p2 <- plot_function(taxa = taxa, dataframe=taxa_alan_temp, taxa_alan_temp$alan_2018, taxa_alan_temp$down_05_2018, "ALAN_2018", "green_down_doy")
grid.arrange(p, p2, ncol = 2)


# making groups and display
p <- make_group_display(point = taxa_alan_temp, trend = "up_05_2018", temp = "tavg_ann_2018") 
#tavg_ann_2018, tavg_spr_2018, tavg_sum_2018, lst_2018
ggsave(str_c("~/phenology-urban/result/alan/bin_daymet_2018_",taxa,"_50up.jpg"), p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")

p
```
